title: Mecklenburg Castle
scope: The existing oval Obotrite fortification at Dorf Mecklenburg, with its surveyed earth banks, ditch, paved northern access and representative present entrance furnishings.
limitations: Planting is a representative sparse grove that preserves the visible surviving earthwork. Individual trees, monuments and graves are not surveyed.
The paved widths and entrance furnishings are approximate. The historic lost timber or masonry superstructure is not reconstructed.
